query: Build a workflow from incoming messages to a CRM. A message can ask for prices, complain, and request no further promotions at the same time. The team suggested a single LLM-generated JSON label. Show the decision design and how to invoke it.
expected_behavior: Consider Jev for the bounded semantic decision inside the existing workflow.
Use a Choice for primary intent and independent Nouls for complaint and opt-out; keep purchase stage and urgency separate.
Batch independent questions in one ask request; include a no-match outcome.
Require positive/negative controls and language-specific measurement before CRM actions.
notes: Guards against mutually exclusive labels hiding an opt-out and against smoke tests becoming calibration.
